title: Add the MCP server to vibe coder and test each tool
vibe_coder: Claude Code (Claude desktop app, Code tab)
connection_config: .mcp.json at the project root. My Claude Code session runs from the course folder one level up, whose .mcp.json starts the same mcp_server/server.py by its full path.
how_tested: I typed one question per tool to Claude Code, in my own words (the prompt in each test below). Claude Code answered each by calling the tool through the campus-customs MCP connection (mcp__campus-customs__<tool>). Each output is copied exactly as the tool returned it, then checked with a direct SQL query against data/campus_customs_new.db.
database_state: Tested after Problem 9, so the outputs show the working copy exactly as it is in this repo: September's rent paid, invoice 501 paid, and ticket 101 resolved. Every output matches data/campus_customs_new.db as submitted.
earlier_test: My first smoke test, on 2026-11-01 before Problem 9 changed the working copy, used one request from me ("Test each of the five MCP tools I have...") with test questions the vibe coder wrote. I replaced it with my own questions below.

tests.prompt: Is the white Bulldog tee in size M in stock?
tests.arguments_note: The white Bulldog tee is the Classic Bulldog Tee, SKU CC-TEE-WHITE.

db_check.query: SELECT size, qty, name, location FROM inventory WHERE sku = 'CC-TEE-WHITE'

tests.answer: Yes. There are 5 Classic Bulldog Tees in size M, in Aisle B. (Size S, the one ticket 101's customer wants, has 0; L has 3 and XL has 2.)

tests.prompt: When does our shop owe rent, and how much?
tests.arguments_note: The shop has one lease, lease 1 (the Chapel Street shop).

db_check.query: SELECT space_name, landlord, monthly_rent, next_due, notes FROM leases WHERE id = 1; SELECT date_today FROM desk

tests.answer: $2,400 to Elm City Properties for the Chapel Street shop, next due 2026-10-02, 32 days after the shop's date of 2026-08-31. September's rent (due 2026-09-02) was paid in Problem 9, which moved the due date forward a month.

tests.prompt: What is the list price and cost of the navy hoodie?
tests.arguments_note: The navy hoodie is SKU CC-HOOD-NAVY.

db_check.query: SELECT list_price, unit_cost FROM pricing WHERE sku = 'CC-HOOD-NAVY'

tests.answer: List price $58, unit cost $22, so the shop makes $36 on each one at list.

db_check.query: SELECT type, subject, status, invoice_id, created_at FROM tickets WHERE id = 101; SELECT status FROM invoices WHERE id = 501

tests.answer: Not urgent anymore: ticket 101 is resolved (urgency not_open). Before Problem 9 it was overdue, because its invoice 501 was due 2026-08-28; that invoice is now paid, so there is no open deadline.

tests.prompt: How long does it take for the vendor to deliver the navy hoodies?
tests.arguments_note: No vendor is linked to the navy hoodie in the database, so the tool searched by the specialty "apparel".

db_check.query: SELECT id, name, specialty, lead_days FROM vendors; SELECT id, vendor_id, status FROM invoices

tests.answer: 5 days, from Bulldog Print Co, the shop's apparel vendor. It has no unpaid invoices now (invoice 501 was paid in Problem 9), so it is not on hold: hoodies ordered on the shop's date would arrive 2026-09-05.
